newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma ranges, short-term depos,forwards soft.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma ranges, short-term depos,forwards soft.

text.p: Greek short-term depos and forex forwards were softer in periods up-to-two months, ecu/drachma was locked in the 307.15/45 range and bonds were holding, dealers said.
"Depos and forex forwards have softened a bit in periods up to two months," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "The central bank's tender did not affect liquidity."

Bank of Greece drained 250 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent via a fixed interest rate tender on Wednesday. The tender was oversubscribed and individual bids were satisfied pro rata at the ensuing allotment ratio of 8.43 percent.
Forex inflows had beefed up liquidity and put more downward pressure on short-term rates, other dealers said.
Ecu/drachma was rangebound between 307.15 and 307.45 on wednesday with more foreign players seen in late dealings.
"It has been more active today than usually but ecu/drachma is still fluctuating between 307.15 and 307.45," a forex dealer at a foreign bank said.
Bond prices were little changed seeking direction in late dealings but trading volume was up, traders said.
"Bonds and FRNs are directionless," said a foreign bank dealer. "Supply is limited and demand is not strong to pull prices up."
Other dealers said they expected bonds and FRNs to consolidate at these levels for a while before resuming their upward course on improved macroeconomic fundamentals.
"We will see price moves when players have incentives to take positions," a bond dealer said. "The prevailing attitude is wait-and-see right now."
The mark was quoted at 157.23/33 from Wednesday's 157.380 fix, the dollar at 271.30/40 drachmas from 271.270 and the ecu at 307.13/23 from 307.370 drachmas.
The National Bank of Greece, the domestic money market's biggest player, quoted the following late rates:
** Overnight at 9.70-10.20
** One week at 9.90-10.40
** Two weeks at 10.00-10.50
** Three weeks at 10.00-10.50
** One month at 10.10-10.60
** Two months at 10.15-10.65
** Three months at 10.20-10.70
** Six months at 10.20-10.70
** Nine months at 10.20-10.70
** Twelve months at 10.20-10.70
